feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Lawmakers seek answers on the national security as Nvidia CEO returns
entry.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are escalating calls to tighten controls on advanced AI chips, as national security questions persist in the wake of Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.

entry.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
entry.summary: "The public is rightly concerned," says the Republican lawmaker, who wants to know what the FBI and CIA knew about potential national security threats and whether Jensen Huang was warned.

entry.title: U.S. government investigating Iranian ties to as many as 50 hacked commercial vessels
entry.summary: A U.S. official tells NPR the government is investigating cyberattacks against as many as 50 commercial ships, with Iran as the potential culprit.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: The Army plans to destroy nearly five tons of lead-based explosives in Iowa, Kilmar Ábrego García has voluntarily left the U.S., Lawmakers raise concerns as Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia's CEO.

entry.title: Director David Fincher discusses 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with director David Fincher about Brad Pitt's return to his Oscar-winning role in "Once Upon a Time in Hollywood." The sequel is "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth."

entry.title: Millions of Americans expected to fly this Thanksgiving
entry.summary: Millions of Americans are expected to hop on a plane to visit friends or family this Thanksgiving. We hear what it's looking like for air travelers this week — and how much it could cost them.

entry.title: California facing flooding threat this week
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez asks Patrick Barnard of the Center for Coastal Climate Resilience at UC Santa Cruz about the flooding threat in California this week.

entry.title: What to know about this year's Thanksgiving matchups
entry.summary: Michel Martin speaks with John Breech from CBS Sports about this year's Thanksgiving eve and Thanksgiving Day matchups.

entry.title: Food critic on what to consider when hosting Thanksgiving at a restaurant
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Washington Post food critic Elazar Sontag about what to consider when gathering for Thanksgiving at a restaurant.

entry.title: 'Dancing with the Stars' crowns new winner in finale
entry.summary: ABC's Dancing with the Stars wrapped up Season 35 and crowned its new winner Tuesday evening.
